text: Chemistry is a fundamental natural science that studies the composition, structure, properties and transformation laws of substances. It is hailed as the "central science" - connecting physics (the movement of microscopic particles) and biology (the mechanisms of life molecules), and is dedicated to solving problems such as "how substances are transformed", "how new materials are designed", and "how chemical reactions are regulated". Its core goals include: revealing the essential laws of material changes, creating new substances, developing energy and materials, and solving environmental and health problems.
